//: brainify writes this to a hub's .claude/settings.local.example.json (committed). Each teammate copies it to .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored by pb sync) and fills in their own tokens. Claude Code passes this env to Bash and to MCP server processes, so servers in .mcp.json read tokens from their environment. Do NOT reference tokens as ${VAR} in .mcp.json: that expansion does not see this file. If you signed in with `glab auth login` / `gh auth login`, delete the matching token line, because the env var overrides that login.

env.GITLAB_TOKEN: glpat-...  (GitLab > Preferences > Access tokens, scope: api)
